brief:
Settlers set fire to portions of the Imad al-Din Zanki mosque in the West Bank village of Bazaria, the Ma'an news agency reported. The incident occurred as tensions remain high across Palestinian communities in occupied territory.

The mosque, which serves the residents of Bazaria, sustained fire damage to multiple sections. Palestinian officials have documented a pattern of attacks on religious and civilian infrastructure by settler groups in recent months. Authorities did not immediately release details on the scale of the damage or whether anyone was injured in the incident.
title: Settlers set fire to sections of mosque in Bazaria village
